conservative.requirements: Play when you or an ally within close range KOs or critically wounds a creature of Chaos or a Heretic. Effect: When you or an ally within close range KOs or critically wounds a creature of Chaos or a Heretic, you may place 6 tokens on this card to immediately gain favour equal to your character rank

Effect: When you or an ally within close range KOs or critically wounds a creature of Chaos or a Heretic, you may place 6 recharge tokens on this card to immediately gain favour equal to your character rank
